instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Montserrat' for all Headings. Import it from Google Fonts.
Use 'Inter' for all Body text. Import it from Google Fonts.
Implement the 'Deep Navy' (#0B1F3B) as the primary brand color.
Use 'Executive Gold' (#C9A227) sparingly for high-impact elements (Buttons, Active States).
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes.
Use Shadcn components (Card, Accordion, Button, Input, Select, Sheet) but customize them to match the 'SquareOne' theme.
Create a 'Navbar' that is sticky, white background, with Navy text and a Gold CTA button.
The 'Services' section should use a Grid layout with hover effects that lift the card.
The 'Process' section should be a horizontal step-by-step guide.
Ensure the site is fully responsive (Mobile First approach).
Use the provided image URLs for their respective sections.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry where possible.
Use 2-3x more spacing (padding/margin) than typical designs.
Add micro-interactions (hover, focus, active) to all clickable elements.
Ensure text contrast meets WCAG AA standards.
Do not use 'transition: all'. Animate specific properties.
